prompt.title: Become a transition person
prompt.text: Some patterns get passed down without anyone choosing them — a way of arguing, a way of handling money, a way of reacting under pressure. Name the scripts you noticed you inherited, decide what to do with each one, and write the version you want to live by instead.
prompt.whyItMatters: A 'transition person' is someone who stops a pattern instead of passing it on. Naming a script on purpose is what makes it possible to choose differently the next time it shows up.

form.textLabel: The script (what you say, do or expect)
form.textRequired: Describe the script before moving on.
form.newScriptLabel: The new script you want instead
form.newScriptRequired: Write the new script when you're rewriting or stopping this one.
form.situationLabel: A situation this week where it applies
form.situationRequired: Name a concrete situation this week.
